words.enDefinition: enrollment at a university in another country for a term or more

examples.en: I never thought I would study abroad until my roommate mentioned the exchange program.
examples.zh: 我从未想过要「出国留学」，直到室友跟我提到交换项目。

examples.en: Study abroad changed how I see myself, and I would do it all again.
examples.zh: 「出国留学」改变了我看待自己的方式，再选一次我还会去。

words.enDefinition: one term spent studying at a partner university overseas

examples.en: I spent my exchange semester in Manchester and made friends from twelve countries.
examples.zh: 我的「交换学期」在曼彻斯特度过，交到了来自十二个国家的朋友。

examples.en: Courses from your exchange semester still count toward your degree back home.
examples.zh: 「交换学期」修的课程依然计入你国内的学位学分。

words.enDefinition: an official arrangement letting students study at partner schools

examples.en: Our exchange program with Seoul National University offers ten places every fall.
examples.zh: 我们与首尔大学的「交换项目」每年秋季提供十个名额。

examples.en: She missed the deadline for her first-choice exchange program but got into another.
examples.zh: 她第一志愿的「交换项目」错过了截止日，但申上了另一个。

collocations: be accepted into an exchange program

words.enDefinition: a student studying temporarily at a foreign partner university

examples.en: As an exchange student, I register for classes after degree students do.
examples.zh: 作为「交换生」，我要等学位学生选完课才能选课。

examples.en: The club pairs each exchange student with a local buddy for the first month.
examples.zh: 社团会让每位「交换生」与一名本地同学结对一个月。

words.enDefinition: the foreign school where an exchange student takes classes

examples.en: My host university emailed the official acceptance letter last Friday.
examples.zh: 我的「接收院校」上周五发来了正式录取信。

examples.en: Tuition goes to your home school, not to the host university.
examples.zh: 学费交给你的母校，而不是「接收院校」。

words.enDefinition: the university where a student is working toward a degree

examples.en: Credits earned abroad must be approved by your home institution first.
examples.zh: 在国外取得的学分必须先得到「原就读学校」的批准。

examples.en: I still pay tuition to my home institution while studying in Toronto.
examples.zh: 在多伦多读书期间，学费仍然缴给「原就读学校」。

collocations: get approval from your home institution
remain enrolled at your home institution

words.enDefinition: a local family that houses a student during their stay

examples.en: My host family drives me to campus every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我的「寄宿家庭」每周一早上开车送我去学校。

examples.en: Living with a host family is the fastest way to practice everyday English.
examples.zh: 住「寄宿家庭」是练习日常英语最快的方式。

words.enDefinition: the foreign nation where an international student is studying

examples.en: Opening a bank account is one of the first tasks in your host country.
examples.zh: 在「留学国家」开银行账户是抵达后最先要办的事之一。

examples.en: Public holidays in the host country are perfect for cheap weekend trips.
examples.zh: 「留学国家」的公共假期最适合安排便宜的周末旅行。

words.enDefinition: a single term of study completed in another country

examples.en: A semester abroad fits my plan better than a full year away.
examples.zh: 比起离开一整年，「海外学期」更符合我的规划。

examples.en: She worked part-time for two years to fund her semester abroad in Sydney.
examples.zh: 她打了两年工，才凑齐在悉尼「海外学期」的费用。

words.enDefinition: a full academic year spent studying in another country

examples.en: Language majors at my university usually complete a compulsory year abroad.
examples.zh: 我们学校的语言专业通常要求完成一个必修的「海外学年」。

examples.en: He chose a year abroad in Berlin to finally get his German right.
examples.zh: 他选择去柏林度过「海外学年」，把德语真正练好。

words.enDefinition: an organized program placing students at foreign universities

examples.en: This study abroad program covers dorm placement, insurance, and airport pickup.
examples.zh: 这个「留学项目」包含宿舍安排、保险和机场接机。

examples.en: Compare housing costs before you commit to a study abroad program.
examples.zh: 在确定参加某个「留学项目」前，先比较住宿费用。

collocations: enroll in a study abroad program

words.enDefinition: the campus office that advises students on studying overseas

examples.en: Bring your questions to the study abroad office during walk-in hours.
examples.zh: 开放咨询时间里，带着问题直接去「留学办公室」。

examples.en: The study abroad office runs an info session every Wednesday this month.
examples.zh: 「留学办公室」本月每周三都有一场说明会。

words.enDefinition: everything a student learns while living and studying overseas

examples.en: Her study abroad experience in Toronto completely changed her career plans.
examples.zh: 她在多伦多的「留学经历」彻底改变了她的职业规划。

examples.en: Write about your study abroad experience in the scholarship essay.
examples.zh: 在奖学金申请文章里写下你的「留学经历」。

collocations: make the most of your study abroad experience
study abroad experience on a resume

words.enDefinition: a campus event where overseas programs recruit interested students

examples.en: I collected brochures from twelve universities at the study abroad fair.
examples.zh: 我在「留学宣讲会」上收集了十二所大学的宣传册。

examples.en: Stop by the study abroad fair on Thursday to meet the coordinators.
examples.zh: 周四来「留学宣讲会」见见各项目的协调员吧。

collocations: a booth at the study abroad fair

words.enDefinition: money awarded to help pay for studying overseas

examples.en: She won a study abroad scholarship that covered her airfare.
examples.zh: 她拿了一笔「留学奖学金」，连机票钱都覆盖了。

examples.en: Applications for the department's study abroad scholarship close in early March.
examples.zh: 系里「留学奖学金」的申请三月初截止。

collocations: apply for a study abroad scholarship

words.enDefinition: a foreign school with an official exchange agreement with yours

examples.en: Our partner universities in Japan each reserve five places for us.
examples.zh: 我们在日本的几所「合作院校」每校为我们保留五个名额。

examples.en: Check which partner universities your department has agreements with first.
examples.zh: 先查一下你们院系与哪些「合作院校」签了协议。

words.enDefinition: a formal contract between two schools to swap students

examples.en: The exchange agreement guarantees an equal number of students both ways.
examples.zh: 这份「交换协议」保证双方互换的学生人数对等。

examples.en: Our exchange agreement with UBC was renewed for another five years.
examples.zh: 我们与英属哥伦比亚大学的「交换协议」又续签了五年。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who manages exchange students and paperwork

examples.en: Ask the exchange coordinator before registering for any course off campus.
examples.zh: 注册任何校外课程之前，先问问「交换协调员」。

examples.en: Our exchange coordinator helped me extend my dorm contract by two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们的「交换协调员」帮我把宿舍合同延长了两周。

words.enDefinition: the forms needed to apply for an exchange place

examples.en: My exchange application included two essays and a language certificate.
examples.zh: 我的「交换申请」包括两篇文章和一份语言证书。

examples.en: Get your exchange application in before the deadline on March first.
examples.zh: 请在三月一日的截止日期前提交「交换申请」。

words.enDefinition: the extra charge a study abroad program requires

examples.en: The program fee covers orientation, insurance, and three day trips.
examples.zh: 「项目费用」涵盖入学指导、保险和三次一日游。

examples.en: Is the program fee paid here or directly to the host university?
examples.zh: 「项目费用」是交给我们学校，还是直接交给接收院校？

words.enDefinition: official selection by your school for an exchange place

examples.en: After my nomination, the partner university sent me their own application form.
examples.zh: 「交换提名」之后，合作院校给我寄来了他们自己的申请表。

examples.en: Nominations for the spring exchange are announced in early October.
examples.zh: 春季交换的「提名」名单在十月初公布。

words.enDefinition: a short overseas course taught by your own professors

examples.en: Her faculty-led program spent three weeks studying architecture in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她参加的「教师带队项目」在维也纳学了三周建筑。

examples.en: Faculty-led programs are usually cheaper than a full semester exchange.
examples.zh: 「教师带队项目」通常比整学期的交换便宜。

words.enDefinition: the nation where a student holds citizenship or residence

examples.en: I call my parents in my home country every Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 每周日晚上，我都会给「本国」的父母打电话。

examples.en: Snacks from your home country cost double at the campus convenience store.
examples.zh: 校内便利店里的「国内」进口零食价格贵一倍。

words.enDefinition: any nation other than your own

examples.en: Studying in a foreign country pushes you to solve problems alone.
examples.zh: 在「外国」求学迫使你学会独自解决问题。

examples.en: My first week in a foreign country was a blur of forms.
examples.zh: 初到「外国」的第一周，全是各种表格，晕头转向。

words.enDefinition: confusion and stress from living in an unfamiliar culture

examples.en: Culture shock hit hardest in week two, once the excitement wore off.
examples.zh: 第二周新鲜感消退时，「文化冲击」来得最猛。

examples.en: Missing your favorite foods is a normal part of culture shock.
examples.zh: 想念家乡菜是「文化冲击」中很正常的一部分。

collocations: a mild case of culture shock

words.enDefinition: disorientation felt when returning to your own culture

examples.en: Reverse culture shock caught me off guard when I flew home for winter break.
examples.zh: 冬假飞回国时，「逆向文化冲击」让我措手不及。

examples.en: Nobody warned me that reverse culture shock could feel worse than arriving abroad.
examples.zh: 没人提醒过我，「逆向文化冲击」可能比刚出国时还难受。

collocations: reverse culture shock after returning home

words.enDefinition: the first excited stage before culture shock sets in

examples.en: During the honeymoon phase, everything about the new city seems charming.
examples.zh: 在「蜜月期」，新城市的一切都显得迷人。

examples.en: The honeymoon phase usually fades within the first month or two.
examples.zh: 「蜜月期」通常会在前一两个月内消退。

collocations: the honeymoon phase of culture shock

words.enDefinition: the process of getting used to a new culture

examples.en: Cultural adjustment takes time, so don't panic when month two feels hard.
examples.zh: 「文化适应」需要时间，第二个月觉得难熬也别慌。

examples.en: The international office runs workshops to support your cultural adjustment.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室开设工作坊，帮助你进行「文化适应」。

words.enDefinition: the time it takes to feel comfortable in a new place

examples.en: Give yourself a proper adjustment period before judging the new city.
examples.zh: 在评价这座新城市之前，先给自己一段像样的「适应期」。

examples.en: My adjustment period was rough, but week six finally felt normal.
examples.zh: 我的「适应期」很煎熬，但第六周终于恢复正常了。

collocations: an adjustment period of a few weeks

words.enDefinition: learning how friendships and social life work in a new place

examples.en: Social adjustment was harder for me than the language itself.
examples.zh: 对我来说，「社交适应」比语言本身更难。

examples.en: Joining two clubs sped up my social adjustment during the first month.
examples.zh: 第一个月加入两个社团，大大加快了我的「社交适应」。

words.enDefinition: a way of living that differs between two cultures

examples.en: Small cultural differences, like calling professors by first name, surprised me.
examples.zh: 一些小的「文化差异」，比如直呼教授的名字，让我很惊讶。

examples.en: We laughed about cultural differences while comparing dorm food stories.
examples.zh: 我们一边比拼各自宿舍的伙食故事，一边笑谈「文化差异」。

words.enDefinition: an accepted way of behaving within a particular culture

examples.en: Tipping is a cultural norm here that simply doesn't exist back home.
examples.zh: 小费是这里的「文化规范」，在我们国内根本不存在。

examples.en: Ask before hugging; a cultural norm in one country can offend elsewhere.
examples.zh: 拥抱前先问一声；一国的「文化规范」在别处可能冒犯人。

words.enDefinition: behavior that a culture silently expects from its members

examples.en: Participating in class carries different cultural expectations in every country.
examples.zh: 课堂发言在每个国家承载着不同的「文化期望」。

examples.en: My host family patiently explained the cultural expectations around punctuality.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭耐心给我讲解了关于守时的「文化期望」。

words.enDefinition: what connects you to the traditions and values of your culture

examples.en: Living abroad made me question my cultural identity for the first time.
examples.zh: 旅居国外让我第一次认真思考自己的「文化身份」。

examples.en: She blends both cultures naturally and never doubts her cultural identity.
examples.zh: 她自然地融合两种文化，从不怀疑自己的「文化身份」。

collocations: a strong sense of cultural identity

words.enDefinition: the distance in understanding between two cultures

examples.en: The culture gap showed the moment my joke confused the whole table.
examples.zh: 我的笑话让全桌人一脸困惑时，「文化隔阂」就显现出来了。

examples.en: Bridging the culture gap takes curiosity more than perfect English.
examples.zh: 弥合「文化隔阂」更需要好奇心，而不是完美的英语。

words.enDefinition: conflict caused when different cultural values meet

examples.en: A small culture clash over shared food broke out in our suite.
examples.zh: 我们套间里因为分食物的问题起了一场小「文化冲突」。

examples.en: Most culture clashes in dorms come from noise and cleaning habits.
examples.zh: 宿舍里大多数「文化冲突」都源于噪音和清洁习惯。

words.enDefinition: the culture of the country you are living in

examples.en: Learning the host culture starts with small things like lunch hours.
examples.zh: 了解「当地文化」要从午餐时间这类小事开始。

examples.en: Students who engage with the host culture report fewer lonely weekends.
examples.zh: 主动接触「当地文化」的学生，独自度过的周末更少。

collocations: immerse yourself in the host culture

words.enDefinition: the culture you grew up in before moving abroad

examples.en: Cooking dishes from my home culture made the dorm feel less foreign.
examples.zh: 做几道「母国文化」里的家常菜，让宿舍少了几分陌生感。

examples.en: Comparing your home culture with the local one is a classic exchange-night chat.
examples.zh: 比较「母国文化」与当地文化，是交换生之夜的经典话题。

words.enDefinition: a confusion caused by different cultural habits or meanings

examples.en: One cultural misunderstanding over a thumbs-up had our whole floor laughing.
examples.zh: 一次关于竖大拇指的「文化误解」，让我们整层楼笑作一团。

examples.en: Most dorm conflicts are small cultural misunderstandings, not real rudeness.
examples.zh: 宿舍里的矛盾多数只是小小的「文化误解」，并非真的无礼。

words.enDefinition: care and respect when dealing with other cultures

examples.en: The residence advisor reminded us to show cultural sensitivity during Ramadan.
examples.zh: 宿管提醒我们在斋月期间要有「文化敏感性」。

examples.en: A little cultural sensitivity prevents most awkward moments in group projects.
examples.zh: 一点「文化敏感性」就能避免小组作业中的大多数尴尬时刻。

words.enDefinition: knowledge and understanding of cultural differences

examples.en: Living with international roommates builds cultural awareness faster than any lecture.
examples.zh: 和国际室友同住，比任何课堂都更能培养「文化意识」。

examples.en: Our dorm floor hosted a trivia night to raise cultural awareness.
examples.zh: 我们楼层办了一场知识问答之夜来提升「文化意识」。

words.enDefinition: the mix of cultures present in a community

examples.en: The cultural diversity at our mixer showed in the four lunch traditions.
examples.zh: 联谊会上四种不同的午餐传统，正是「文化多样性」的体现。

examples.en: I chose this university partly because of its incredible cultural diversity.
examples.zh: 我选择这所大学，部分原因就是它惊人的「文化多样性」。

words.enDefinition: including or involving several different cultures

examples.en: Ours is a very multicultural campus, with students from ninety countries.
examples.zh: 我们是一所非常「多元文化」的学校，学生来自九十多个国家。

examples.en: The multicultural food festival on the quad sold out within an hour.
examples.zh: 草坪上的「多元文化」美食节一小时内就卖光了。

words.enDefinition: a custom passed down within a culture

examples.en: My roommate invited me to join her cultural tradition of sharing mooncakes.
examples.zh: 室友邀请我加入她分月饼的「文化传统」。

examples.en: Explaining a cultural tradition from home always draws a curious crowd.
examples.zh: 介绍家乡的一种「文化传统」，总能引来一圈好奇的人。

words.enDefinition: to get used to a new climate or situation

examples.en: It took me a month to acclimate to the dry mountain air.
examples.zh: 我花了一个月才「适应」这里干燥的山地空气。

examples.en: International students usually acclimate faster when they arrive before orientation week.
examples.zh: 国际学生如果赶在迎新周之前到校，通常「适应」得更快。

words.enDefinition: the shared habits of how classes are run

examples.en: Interrupting with questions is normal in the American classroom culture.
examples.zh: 在美国的「课堂文化」里，提问打断很正常。

examples.en: The classroom culture here expects debate, which took me weeks to accept.
examples.zh: 这里的「课堂文化」鼓励辩论，我花了几周才接受。

words.enDefinition: sharing customs, food, and ideas between cultures

examples.en: Our floor organizes a cultural exchange night every other Friday.
examples.zh: 我们楼层每隔一个周五办一次「文化交流」之夜。

examples.en: Teaching each other card games became our favorite form of cultural exchange.
examples.zh: 互相教扑克牌玩法，成了我们最喜欢的「文化交流」方式。

words.enDefinition: a friendship between people from different cultures

examples.en: My closest cross-cultural friendship started over a shared complaint about dining hall food.
examples.zh: 我最深的「跨文化友谊」，始于一起吐槽食堂的饭菜。

examples.en: Cross-cultural friendships take effort at first but become the richest ones.
examples.zh: 「跨文化友谊」起初需要用心经营，最终却最为珍贵。

words.enDefinition: to feel accepted by a group or place

examples.en: Joining the hiking club finally helped me fit in on campus.
examples.zh: 参加远足社团，终于让我在校园里「融入」了大家。

examples.en: It is fine if you don't fit in during the first few weeks.
examples.zh: 头几周没能「融入」也完全没关系。

words.enDefinition: to look or behave like the people around you

examples.en: After a semester here, I finally blend in at the dining hall.
examples.zh: 在这里待了一个学期后，我在食堂终于能「融入人群」了。

examples.en: Locals blend in by dressing simply; my bright jacket gave me away.
examples.zh: 当地人穿得素净才能「融入人群」，我那件亮色外套一眼就暴露了。

words.enDefinition: difficulty communicating across different languages

examples.en: The language barrier turned my first pharmacy trip into a forty-minute mission.
examples.zh: 「语言障碍」让我第一次去药店花了四十分钟。

examples.en: We broke the language barrier with translation apps and plenty of patience.
examples.zh: 我们靠翻译软件和足够的耐心打破了「语言障碍」。

words.enDefinition: getting used to hearing and understanding local accents

examples.en: Accent adaptation takes about two weeks of daily listening practice.
examples.zh: 每天坚持听，两周左右就能完成「口音适应」。

examples.en: Podcasts helped my accent adaptation more than classroom listening drills did.
examples.zh: 播客对我的「口音适应」帮助比课堂听力训练更大。

words.enDefinition: an accent that is strong and hard to follow

examples.en: My professor has a thick accent, so I record every lecture.
examples.zh: 教授「口音很重」，所以我每堂课都录音。

examples.en: She worried about her thick accent until classmates called it charming.
examples.zh: 她曾担心自己「口音重」，直到同学们说那很迷人。

words.enDefinition: a person you practice languages with, taking turns

examples.en: My language exchange partner wants Mandarin practice, and I need English help.
examples.zh: 我的「语伴」想练中文，而我也需要人帮我练英语。

examples.en: We meet our language exchange partners at the campus cafe every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我们每周二在校内咖啡馆与「语伴」碰面。

words.enDefinition: regular speaking practice to improve fluency

examples.en: Twenty minutes of daily conversation practice beats two hours of grammar drills.
examples.zh: 每天二十分钟「会话练习」，胜过两小时语法刷题。

examples.en: The language center offers free conversation practice with trained student volunteers.
examples.zh: 语言中心提供由受过培训的学生志愿者带队的免费「会话练习」。

words.enDefinition: a required language score for admission or exchange

examples.en: Check the language requirement before you even apply for the exchange.
examples.zh: 申请交换之前，先查清楚「语言要求」。

examples.en: Her latest test score met the language requirement for the Oslo program.
examples.zh: 她最新的考试成绩达到了奥斯陆项目的「语言要求」。

words.enDefinition: an exam measuring how well you use a language

examples.en: Book your proficiency test early because the slots fill up fast.
examples.zh: 「水平测试」的考位很快就会被订满，记得尽早报名。

examples.en: He passed the proficiency test with a speaking score of seven.
examples.zh: 他通过了「水平测试」，口语拿了七分。

words.enDefinition: someone who grew up speaking a language

examples.en: Even native speakers from different regions argue about the local slang.
examples.zh: 即使是「母语者」，不同地区的人也会为当地俚语争论。

examples.en: Don't be shy; native speakers mishear words in noisy cafes too.
examples.zh: 别害羞；嘈杂的咖啡馆里，「母语者」也会听错词。

words.enDefinition: a language learned in addition to your first one

examples.en: Studying abroad turns classroom English into a working second language.
examples.zh: 留学让课堂英语变成真正能用的「第二语言」。

examples.en: Dreaming in your second language is a milestone worth celebrating.
examples.zh: 用「第二语言」做梦，是值得庆祝的里程碑。

words.enDefinition: a language that is not your own

examples.en: Taking notes in a foreign language gets faster every single month.
examples.zh: 用「外语」记笔记，每个月都会快一些。

examples.en: My host family helps me practice the foreign language at dinner.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭会在晚饭时帮我练习「外语」。

words.enDefinition: learning by using only the target language daily

examples.en: Total language immersion felt brutal during the first two weeks.
examples.zh: 头两周完全的「语言沉浸」让我非常难受。

examples.en: Language immersion works best once you stop clinging to compatriots.
examples.zh: 不再总黏着同胞时，「语言沉浸」的效果最好。

words.enDefinition: a phone app that translates text or speech instantly

examples.en: A translation app saved me at both the pharmacy and the bank.
examples.zh: 「翻译软件」在药店和银行都帮了我大忙。

examples.en: Point your translation app at the menu and order with confidence.
examples.zh: 把「翻译软件」对准菜单，就能放心点单了。

words.enDefinition: able to use two languages equally well

examples.en: Growing up bilingual, she moves between two friend groups effortlessly.
examples.zh: 从小「双语」长大，她在两个朋友圈之间自如切换。

examples.en: Our international fair needs bilingual volunteers at the welcome desk.
examples.zh: 国际文化节需要在迎新台安排「双语」志愿者。

words.enDefinition: very informal words used among local speakers

examples.en: Local slang confused me until a classmate wrote down the common phrases.
examples.zh: 直到同学把常用短语写下来，我才搞懂那些「俚语」。

examples.en: Every campus invents its own slang for buildings and traditions.
examples.zh: 每个校园都有自己的「俚语」来称呼教学楼和传统活动。

words.enDefinition: a weekly social hour for international and local students

examples.en: International coffee hour happens every Friday afternoon in the global lounge.
examples.zh: 「国际咖啡时间」每周五下午在全球学生休息室举行。

examples.en: I practiced small talk at international coffee hour before daring to chat in class.
examples.zh: 我先在「国际咖啡时间」练闲聊，才敢在课堂上开口交流。

words.enDefinition: a campus space dedicated to international students and friends

examples.en: The global lounge offers free tea, board games, and travel guides.
examples.zh: 「全球学生休息室」提供免费茶水、桌游和旅行攻略。

examples.en: Leave your backpack in the global lounge during our language exchange session.
examples.zh: 做语言交换活动时，把背包放在「全球学生休息室」就好。

collocations: hang out in the global lounge

words.enDefinition: a student group that supports and unites international students

examples.en: The international student association runs airport pickup on every arrival day.
examples.zh: 「国际学生协会」在每个入境日安排机场接机。

examples.en: Joining the international student association gave me friends before classes even started.
examples.zh: 加入「国际学生协会」，让我在开学前就交到了朋友。

words.enDefinition: the network of international students and staff on campus

examples.en: Our international community organizes shared dinners throughout the exam season.
examples.zh: 我们的「国际学生社群」在考试季组织了多次聚餐。

examples.en: The international community here makes homesickness much easier to carry.
examples.zh: 这里的「国际学生社群」让想家的情绪容易承受许多。

words.enDefinition: a formal greeting event for newly arrived students

examples.en: The dean greeted every new international student at the welcome reception.
examples.zh: 院长在「迎新招待会」上问候了每位新到的国际学生。

examples.en: You can grab a free campus T-shirt at Friday's welcome reception.
examples.zh: 周五的「迎新招待会」上可以领一件免费校园文化衫。

words.enDefinition: a shared dinner celebrating newly arrived students

examples.en: The welcome dinner pairs each newcomer with a returning student.
examples.zh: 「迎新晚宴」为每位新生配对一名返校老生。

examples.en: Sign up for the welcome dinner through the international office form.
examples.zh: 通过国际学生办公室的表格报名「迎新晚宴」。

collocations: a welcome dinner for exchange students

words.enDefinition: a small informal social gathering

examples.en: Our floor hosts a Friday get-together with snacks from different countries.
examples.zh: 我们楼层每周五办一场「聚会」，摆出各国零食。

examples.en: A quick get-together in the lounge is the easiest way to meet neighbors.
examples.zh: 在休息室来一场小型「聚会」，是认识邻居最简单的方式。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed one-on-one conversation over coffee

examples.en: I asked a senior for a coffee chat about surviving freshman year.
examples.zh: 我约了一位学长「咖啡闲聊」，请教怎么熬过大一。

examples.en: After one fifteen-minute coffee chat, we had planned a whole road trip.
examples.zh: 一次十五分钟的「咖啡闲聊」后，我们已经计划好一次公路旅行。

collocations: invite someone for a coffee chat

words.enDefinition: a friend who travels with you on trips

examples.en: My travel buddy and I split the hostel and train costs evenly.
examples.zh: 我和「旅伴」平摊了青旅和火车票的费用。

examples.en: Finding a travel buddy for reading week takes one group chat message.
examples.zh: 在群里发一条消息，就能为读书周找到「旅伴」。

collocations: split costs with your travel buddy

words.enDefinition: a student who is not classified as international

examples.en: Our suite mixes two domestic students with three international students.
examples.zh: 我们套间住着两位「本地学生」和三位国际学生。

examples.en: The pairing scheme matches every international student with a domestic student.
examples.zh: 结对方案为每位国际学生配对一名「本地学生」。

words.enDefinition: a roommate assigned from another country

examples.en: My international roommate taught me to cook rice three different ways.
examples.zh: 我的「国际室友」教会我用三种方法做米饭。

examples.en: Housing asked whether I would accept an international roommate this fall.
examples.zh: 宿舍部门问我今年秋季是否愿意接受一名「国际室友」。

words.enDefinition: someone who feels connected to the whole world

examples.en: A year in Leeds turned my shy roommate into a real global citizen.
examples.zh: 在利兹的一年，让我害羞的室友真正成了「世界公民」。

examples.en: The program aims to shape graduates into responsible global citizens.
examples.zh: 该项目致力于把毕业生培养成有担当的「世界公民」。

words.enDefinition: a view shaped by understanding many cultures

examples.en: Group projects with exchange students gave me a genuinely global perspective.
examples.zh: 和交换生一起做小组作业，让我有了真正的「全球视野」。

examples.en: Employers value graduates who bring a global perspective to the team.
examples.zh: 雇主看重能为团队带来「全球视野」的毕业生。

words.enDefinition: someone raised across several cultures between identities

examples.en: As a third culture kid, she calls three different cities home.
examples.zh: 作为「第三文化小孩」，她把三个城市都称作家。

examples.en: Third culture kids often bond instantly when they meet at international mixers.
examples.zh: 「第三文化小孩」在国际联谊会上常常一见如故。

collocations: a third culture kid growing up abroad

words.enDefinition: a place where you feel as comfortable as home

examples.en: The global lounge became my home away from home within a month.
examples.zh: 不出一个月，全球学生休息室就成了我的「第二个家」。

examples.en: My host family made this whole city feel like a home away from home.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭让整座城市都成了我的「第二个家」。

collocations: feel like a home away from home
a true home away from home
make campus a home away from home

words.enDefinition: to feel relaxed and comfortable in a place

examples.en: You will feel at home here once you learn the bus routes.
examples.zh: 熟悉了公交线路，你就会在这里「感觉像在家」一样。

examples.en: By the second week, I finally started to feel at home.
examples.zh: 到了第二周，我终于开始「感觉像在家」了。

words.enDefinition: the feeling of being accepted in a community

examples.en: Volunteering at the welcome desk gave me a real sense of belonging.
examples.zh: 在迎新台做志愿者，让我有了真正的「归属感」。

examples.en: A sense of belonging grows from small rituals, like our Sunday dinners.
examples.zh: 「归属感」来自一次次小小的固定仪式，比如周日聚餐。

words.enDefinition: feeling uncomfortable because you do not belong somewhere

examples.en: Everyone already knew each other, which made me feel out of place.
examples.zh: 大家彼此都认识，让我觉得自己「格格不入」。

examples.en: I felt out of place until someone asked about my hometown food.
examples.zh: 直到有人问起我家乡的美食，我「格格不入」的感觉才消散。

collocations: feel out of place at first

words.enDefinition: a place with unfamiliar people and routines

examples.en: Be patient with yourself while settling into a completely new environment.
examples.zh: 面对全新的「新环境」，对自己耐心一点。

examples.en: A new environment feels easier once you build a routine in week one.
examples.zh: 第一周就建立起作息，「新环境」会好过很多。

words.enDefinition: to start conversation with strangers comfortably

examples.en: Asking where everyone is from is the easiest way to break the ice.
examples.zh: 问大家都来自哪里，是最简单的「打破僵局」的方式。

examples.en: Our RA used a card game to break the ice on move-in night.
examples.zh: 入住之夜，宿管用桌游来「打破僵局」。

collocations: break the ice at a mixer
an easy way to break the ice
break the ice with new roommates

words.enDefinition: the group of people you spend time with

examples.en: My social circle now includes friends from five different continents.
examples.zh: 我的「社交圈」如今横跨五大洲。

examples.en: Don't limit your social circle to people who speak your language.
examples.zh: 别把「社交圈」局限在说同一种语言的人里。

words.enDefinition: to keep communicating with someone over time

examples.en: My exchange friends and I still stay in touch through a group chat.
examples.zh: 交换时认识的朋友和我至今还在群里「保持联系」。

examples.en: Promise to stay in touch, because exchange goodbyes arrive faster than expected.
examples.zh: 答应我你会「保持联系」，因为交换的离别总来得比想象快。

collocations: stay in touch after the exchange

words.enDefinition: to expand your experience and understanding of the world

examples.en: Studying abroad is honestly the fastest way to broaden your horizons.
examples.zh: 说实话，留学是「开阔眼界」最快的方式。

examples.en: Take one course outside your major to broaden your horizons this term.
examples.zh: 这学期选一门专业之外的课来「开阔眼界」。

collocations: a chance to broaden your horizons

words.enDefinition: the familiar situations where you feel safe

examples.en: Speaking English at every meal pushed me outside my comfort zone.
examples.zh: 每顿饭都说英语，把我推出了「舒适区」。

examples.en: Growth starts right at the edge of your comfort zone.
examples.zh: 成长恰恰始于「舒适区」的边缘。

words.enDefinition: surprising you with new knowledge or views

examples.en: Volunteering at the food bank was an eye-opening experience for me.
examples.zh: 在食物银行做志愿者，是一次让我「大开眼界」的经历。

examples.en: Her exchange semester in Nairobi proved completely eye-opening for her.
examples.zh: 她在内罗毕的交换学期令她彻底「大开眼界」。

words.enDefinition: having a major effect on how you live

examples.en: My host sister calls that summer abroad a life-changing year.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭的姐姐把那段暑期交流称作「改变人生」的一年。

examples.en: One life-changing conversation with my advisor redirected my whole degree plan.
examples.zh: 与导师一次「改变人生」的谈话，改写了我整个学位规划。

words.enDefinition: unlikely ever to happen again in your life

examples.en: A fully funded semester in Kyoto is a once-in-a-lifetime chance.
examples.zh: 在京都免费交换一个学期，是「一生一次」的机会。

examples.en: We caught the northern lights during a once-in-a-lifetime trip up north.
examples.zh: 我们在「一生一次」的北方之旅中看到了北极光。

words.enDefinition: happy and sad feelings mixed together

examples.en: Packing for the flight home felt bittersweet after ten months abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外十个月后收拾行李回国，心情「苦乐参半」。

examples.en: The farewell dinner was bittersweet, full of laughter and a few tears.
examples.zh: 告别晚餐「苦乐参半」，笑声里掺着几滴眼泪。

words.enDefinition: following the rules attached to your student visa

examples.en: The international office emailed every student a visa compliance checklist.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室给每位学生发了「签证合规」清单。

examples.en: Dropping below the full-time credit count can break visa compliance rules.
examples.zh: 学分低于全日制标准可能违反「签证合规」规定。

words.enDefinition: the school notifying immigration about your enrollment

examples.en: Enrollment reporting happens automatically once the add-drop deadline finally passes.
examples.zh: 退补选截止后，「注册状态上报」会自动完成。

examples.en: Late registration causes problems because enrollment reporting goes straight to immigration.
examples.zh: 晚注册会带来麻烦，因为「注册状态上报」直接对接移民部门。

words.enDefinition: your current legal standing under a visa type

examples.en: Ask the advisor before any change that could affect your visa status.
examples.zh: 任何可能影响「签证状态」的变动，都要先问顾问。

examples.en: Her visa status changed to student once the program registered her.
examples.zh: 项目为她注册后，她的「签证状态」变更为学生类别。

words.enDefinition: a registration block due to missing immigration documents

examples.en: An immigration hold blocked my registration until I uploaded the new document.
examples.zh: 在我上传新文件之前，「移民文件冻结」一直挡着我的注册。

examples.en: Clear your immigration hold at the international office before classes start.
examples.zh: 开学前先去国际学生办公室解除「移民文件冻结」。

collocations: an immigration hold on my account

words.enDefinition: to keep satisfying the rules of your visa

examples.en: You must maintain status by staying enrolled full-time every term.
examples.zh: 你必须每学期保持全日制注册来「维持身份」。

examples.en: Check with the advisor before traveling so you can maintain status smoothly.
examples.zh: 出行前先咨询顾问，好让你顺利「维持身份」。

words.enDefinition: the course load rules tied to your status

examples.en: The enrollment requirement for international students is twelve credits each term.
examples.zh: 国际学生的「注册要求」是每学期十二个学分。

examples.en: Falling short of the enrollment requirement requires approval well in advance.
examples.zh: 达不到「注册要求」需要提前很久获得批准。

words.enDefinition: being registered for the required full course load

examples.en: Full-time enrollment usually means at least twelve credits per semester.
examples.zh: 「全日制注册」通常指每学期至少修十二个学分。

examples.en: Confirm your full-time enrollment before the tenth day of classes.
examples.zh: 请在开学第十天前确认「全日制注册」状态。

words.enDefinition: the official start and end dates of your program

examples.en: Your program dates must match the dates printed on your admission letter.
examples.zh: 你的「项目起止日期」必须与录取信上印的日期一致。

examples.en: Arrive a few days before the program dates so you can settle in.
examples.zh: 在「项目起止日期」前几天到达，好安顿下来。

words.enDefinition: an official paper that proves your legal status

examples.en: Keep your immigration document in the same folder as your passport.
examples.zh: 把「移民文件」和护照放在同一个文件夹里。

examples.en: Scan every immigration document before traveling during the winter break.
examples.zh: 冬假出行前，把每份「移民文件」都扫描存档。

words.enDefinition: the forms and documents immigration rules require

examples.en: The coordinator checked my immigration paperwork line by line, twice.
examples.zh: 协调员把我的「移民手续」文件逐行检查了两遍。

examples.en: Start your immigration paperwork early because some documents take weeks.
examples.zh: 尽早着手「移民手续」，有些文件要等好几周。

collocations: immigration paperwork for the visa office

words.enDefinition: an extra charge applied only to international students

examples.en: The international student fee covers orientation and year-round support services.
examples.zh: 「国际学生费用」涵盖迎新和全年的支持服务。

examples.en: Ask the bursar why the international student fee appears twice on my bill.
examples.zh: 问一下缴费处，为什么我的账单上「国际学生费用」出现了两次。

words.enDefinition: the higher tuition rate charged to non-resident students

examples.en: International students pay out-of-state tuition at most public universities here.
examples.zh: 这里的多数公立大学对国际学生收取「州外学费」。

examples.en: Her departmental scholarship cut the out-of-state tuition roughly in half.
examples.zh: 她的院系奖学金把「州外学费」减掉了差不多一半。

words.enDefinition: health coverage the university requires students to carry

examples.en: Student health insurance is billed to my account automatically each semester.
examples.zh: 「学生医疗保险」每学期自动计入我的账户。

examples.en: You can waive student health insurance if your own plan meets the criteria.
examples.zh: 如果你自己的保单符合标准，可以豁免「学生医疗保险」。

words.enDefinition: approval to skip the school's insurance plan

examples.en: Submit your insurance waiver form before the September fifteenth deadline.
examples.zh: 请在九月十五日的截止日前提交「保险豁免」申请表。

examples.en: My insurance waiver was approved because my family's plan covers me here.
examples.zh: 我的「保险豁免」获批了，因为家里的保单在这里也有效。

words.enDefinition: a ride arranged to collect you from the airport

examples.en: Sign up for airport pickup at least one week before your flight.
examples.zh: 至少在航班起飞前一周报名「机场接机」。

examples.en: The airport pickup volunteers held a sign with my name at arrivals.
examples.zh: 「机场接机」志愿者在到达厅举着写有我名字的牌子。

words.enDefinition: the day you are scheduled to enter the country

examples.en: Book a flight that lands a few days before your official arrival date.
examples.zh: 订一个在正式「抵达日期」前几天落地的航班。

examples.en: Housing activates my room key on the stated arrival date.
examples.zh: 宿舍会在规定「抵达日期」当天激活我的房卡。

words.enDefinition: a small formal photo used on official documents

examples.en: Bring one passport photo for your official library card application.
examples.zh: 办理正式图书馆卡要带一张「护照规格照片」。

examples.en: The photo booth near the bookstore prints passport photos for five dollars.
examples.zh: 书店旁的自助照相亭可以打印「护照规格照片」，五美元一套。

words.enDefinition: a task list to finish before leaving home

examples.en: The pre-departure checklist includes visa copies, prescriptions, and adapter plugs.
examples.zh: 「行前清单」包括签证复印件、常用药和转换插头。

examples.en: Print out the pre-departure checklist from the international office website.
examples.zh: 从国际学生办公室网站把「行前清单」打印出来。

words.enDefinition: a task list to complete during your first days

examples.en: My arrival checklist covered check-in, phone setup, and a bank visit.
examples.zh: 我的「抵达清单」包括报到、办手机卡和跑一趟银行。

examples.en: The housing office emails every newcomer an arrival checklist in August.
examples.zh: 宿舍办公室八月会给每位新生发一份「抵达清单」。

words.enDefinition: a phone call made to another country

examples.en: An international call to my grandma costs almost nothing over dorm Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 走宿舍无线网络给奶奶打「国际长途」，几乎不花钱。

examples.en: Time zones turn a simple international call into a scheduling puzzle.
examples.zh: 时差让一通普通的「国际长途」变成了排时间的难题。

words.enDefinition: to phone your family back in your country

examples.en: I call home every Sunday evening when the market closes back in Chengdu.
examples.zh: 每周日晚上成都的菜市场收摊时，我都会「给家里打电话」。

examples.en: Call home right after check-in so your parents can finally relax.
examples.zh: 报到后马上「给家里打电话」，让父母终于放下心。

words.enDefinition: a call placed to someone far away

examples.en: Grandma still calls it a long-distance call even on the video app.
examples.zh: 即使在视频软件上，奶奶还是把这叫「长途电话」。

examples.en: A late-night long-distance call with Mom always settles my nerves.
examples.zh: 深夜和妈妈的一通「长途电话」总能让我安心。

words.enDefinition: a phone plan that discounts calls to other countries

examples.en: Ask the carrier to add an international calling plan to my number.
examples.zh: 让运营商给我的号码加上「国际通话套餐」。

examples.en: Without an international calling plan, that hospital call cost twenty dollars.
examples.zh: 没办「国际通话套餐」，那通医院的电话花了我二十美元。

words.enDefinition: a monthly contract for calls, texts, and data

examples.en: Student phone plans usually beat the tourist SIM cards sold at the airport.
examples.zh: 学生「手机套餐」通常比机场卖的游客电话卡划算。

examples.en: Compare each phone plan's data cap before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 签合同前，比较一下每款「手机套餐」的流量上限。

collocations: sign up for a phone plan

words.enDefinition: the company that provides your phone service

examples.en: Every phone carrier runs some kind of back-to-school promotion in September.
examples.zh: 九月每家「运营商」都会推出某种开学促销。

examples.en: Ask which phone carrier has coverage in your dorm basement.
examples.zh: 问清楚哪家「运营商」的信号能覆盖宿舍地下室。

words.enDefinition: a plan that supplies or limits mobile internet

examples.en: My data plan resets on the fifth, so I download lectures then.
examples.zh: 我的「流量套餐」每月五号重置，所以我那时才下载课程视频。

examples.en: Pick a data plan with hotspot sharing if your dorm Wi-Fi is weak.
examples.zh: 如果宿舍无线信号差，就选一个带热点共享的「流量套餐」。

words.enDefinition: a built-in digital SIM activated without a plastic card

examples.en: Activating an eSIM online saved me a trip to the phone store.
examples.zh: 在线激活「嵌入式手机卡」，省得我跑一趟营业厅。

examples.en: Buy a regional eSIM before landing and it works the moment you land.
examples.zh: 落地前买好区域性「嵌入式手机卡」，一下飞机就能用。

words.enDefinition: a phone number issued in your new country

examples.en: Banks here only send verification codes to a local number.
examples.zh: 这里的银行只把验证码发到「本地号码」。

examples.en: Save your local number somewhere before your parents panic-call the university.
examples.zh: 把你的「本地号码」记在别处，免得父母慌忙打电话给学校。

collocations: text your local number to family

words.enDefinition: the hour gap between your location and home

examples.en: The twelve-hour time zone difference makes my morning their midnight.
examples.zh: 十二小时的「时差」，意味着我的清晨是他们的深夜。

examples.en: We scheduled our weekly video call around the time zone difference.
examples.zh: 我们围绕「时差」安排了每周的视频通话时间。

collocations: adjust to the time zone difference

words.enDefinition: an app used for chatting, calls, and sharing files

examples.en: Our project team lives inside a messaging app because everyone is abroad.
examples.zh: 因为大家都在国外，项目小组全靠「即时通讯软件」沟通。

examples.en: Which messaging app does your host family actually check every day?
examples.zh: 你的寄宿家庭每天真的会看哪款「即时通讯软件」？

words.enDefinition: turning foreign grades into your school's scale

examples.en: Grade conversion for my Manchester courses took the registrar six weeks.
examples.zh: 教务处花了六周才完成我曼彻斯特课程的「成绩换算」。

examples.en: Ask how grade conversion treats pass-fail courses before you choose them.
examples.zh: 选课之前先问清楚，「成绩换算」如何处理合格与不合格课程。

words.enDefinition: the familiar dishes someone's family makes at home

examples.en: Nothing fixes a rough week like an aunt's home cooking.
examples.zh: 没有什么比姑姑做的「家常菜」更能治愈糟糕的一周。

examples.en: She trades her home cooking for my dumplings every Friday night.
examples.zh: 每周五晚上，她用她的「家常菜」换我包的饺子。

words.enDefinition: a romance maintained across cities or countries

examples.en: Their long-distance relationship survived two whole semesters on different continents.
examples.zh: 他们的「异地恋」在两个大洲之间撑过了整整两个学期。

examples.en: A long-distance relationship needs scheduled calls, not just spontaneous texts.
examples.zh: 「异地恋」需要固定的通话安排，而不是只靠随口的消息。

collocations: a long-distance relationship across time zones

words.enDefinition: dishes from many different countries

examples.en: The international cuisine night featured dumplings, jollof rice, and fresh tacos.
examples.zh: 「各国美食」之夜有饺子、西非烩饭和现做塔可。

examples.en: Our club fundraises by selling international cuisine at the winter market.
examples.zh: 我们社团在冬季集市上卖「各国美食」来筹款。
